welcomeIntro.message: One Chrome window for every project. Three quick steps and you're set

welcomePinText.message: Chrome tucks new extensions behind the puzzle icon. Click it, then the pin next to Slate, so your projects are one click away

welcomeCreateText.message: Name it after something you work on. Slate opens a fresh window for it and saves its tabs as you go

welcomeCreated.message: “$NAME$” is open in a new window

welcomeCreateFailed.message: Couldn't create the project. Try again from the Slate icon

welcomeExistingWindow.message: Already have a window full of tabs for it? Open Slate in that window and click the folder with a plus to save it as a project

welcomeSwitchText.message: Click the Slate icon and pick a project: Slate opens its window or brings it to the front

welcomeSwitchText2.message: The letter on the icon shows which project the window belongs to. Close a project window any time, its tabs stay saved

welcomeManagerText.message: Rename, reorder and recolor projects, or back them up, in the side panel

welcomeCliText.message: Prefer the terminal? Open and close projects with the optional slate command

welcomePrivacy.message: Everything stays in this browser: no account, no tracking, no servers

reviewPromptText.message: Enjoying Slate? A short review helps other people find it
